name: Seedance 2.0
tagline: Real AI video with precise reference control
blurb: The best quality: real moving people, products and places, with sound, up to 1080p.
goodAt: People using or wearing your product
Dialogue and sound in one clip
examples: 0-2 s: close-up of the phone from Image 1 turning slowly on a wooden table in a sunny Kigali cafe; 2-5 s: a hand picks it up and the camera pushes in on the screen. Soft afrobeat in the background.
A young woman in a bright ankara top walks through a busy Kigali market holding the handbag from Image 1, turns and smiles at the camera. Handheld tracking shot, natural market sounds.
Slow dolly through the living room of the house in Image 1 at golden hour, curtains moving in the breeze, then out to the balcony with a view of the Kigali hills. Calm piano.

name: Seedance 2.0 Fast
tagline: Real AI video, quicker and cheaper
blurb: Seedance 2.0 at a lower price and faster: the everyday choice for social posts.
examples: Fresh passion-fruit juice is poured into a glass full of ice, slow-motion splash, macro shot, warm morning light; the bottle from Image 1 stands beside it. Sound of pouring and ice.
The sneakers from Image 1 step onto a wet street at night, neon reflections, the camera follows low at ground level, then rises to show the full shoe. Bass-heavy beat.
A barber finishes a fade haircut, brushes the client's shoulders and turns the chair to the mirror; the client smiles. Warm salon light, clippers buzzing.

name: Seedance 2.0 Mini
tagline: Real AI video at the best price
blurb: The cheapest real video: about half the price of Seedance 2.0, good for drafts and simple scenes.
examples: The perfume bottle from Image 1 stands on a mirror surface, soft light sweeps across it, petals fall slowly around it. Fixed camera.
Steam rises from a plate of brochettes and fried plantains on a restaurant table, the camera slowly pushes in. Sizzling sound.
A delivery rider on a moto stops in front of a shop, takes a box from the bag and hands it over with a smile. Daylight, street sounds.

name: Seedance 2.5
blurb: ByteDance's next video model. It arrives in the studio with the BytePlus key.
examples: A 15-second launch film: the phone from Image 1 rises out of the dark, light traces its edges, then a hand takes it into a bright Kigali street.
A chef plates a dish in three moves, each a new camera angle, ending on the restaurant's sign. Kitchen sounds.

name: Claude 3D motion
blurb: Claude designs an animated 3D-style video from your photos: camera moves, text, music and captions, in about a minute.
examples: Price drop reveal: the old price crossed out, the new price in big 3D letters, then the phone turning with a light sweep.
Three reasons to choose us, one per scene, with bold text and a smooth camera push on each photo.
New arrival: start on a close-up detail, pull back to the full product, end with the WhatsApp number.

name: Nano Banana
tagline: Realistic AI images from text and your photos
blurb: Google's Gemini image model: describe a picture, add up to 3 photos, get a realistic image to post or to use in a video.
examples: The product from Image 1 on a clean white marble table, soft morning light, green plants behind, a premium advert photo.
A fictional young Rwandan woman holding the product from Image 1 on a sunny Kigali street, smiling, smartphone photo.
Top-view flat-lay of the product from Image 1 with fresh fruit and leaves around it, bright colours.
